query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
            FROM users u
            WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND ($1::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM user_companies uc
                    WHERE uc.user_id = u.id AND uc.company_id = $1))
              AND ($2::text IS NULL
                    OR u.full_name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
                    OR u.email ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
